gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed at 24-28 weeks gestation
gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed <24 weeks gestation
cohort: 1471 pregnant women with GDM diagnosed using IADPSG criteria between September 2012 and April 2016 in Ireland
finding: Women diagnosed with GDM <24 weeks gestation and their offspring are at greater risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes compared with those diagnosed at 24-28 weeks.
mod_finding: Rates of C-section and pre-maturity were still higher in the early GDM group when the two groups where compared based on their post-natal OGTT.
